title: Oricopper
description: Copper and metallic textures for Oritech
body:
![Drone Port with Fluid Pipes and Item Pipes running into it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6449bd2656a7510c442ff1c2881dfa5a5a08a5d5.png)

Oricopper is a texture pack for Oritech that simply changes the default Orange Paint color for most of the machines to be consistent with Minecraft's copper color scheme.



![Left to right: Fluid Pipe, Opaque Item Pipe, Transparent Item Pipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62d2d47b09df862c40f61fe4ffe21bf7f31909a1.png)

It also retextures the Fluid Pipe, Opaque Item Pipe, and Transparent Item Pipe to match their materials better.


This pack contains recolored versions of textures from [Oritech Consistent Pipes Retexture](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/oritech-consistent-pipes-retexture).
